newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares held up by SAP, watch Wall St.
newsitem.headline: German shares held up by SAP, watch Wall St.

text.p: German shares were mainly firmly ahead late on Friday, led higher by software group SAP AG, but were keeping a wary eye on Wall Street for their next direction.
The IBIS DAX index, having wobbled a little in early afternoon trade after the release of key U.S. data, was up 19 points at 3,037.58 at 1455 GMT, not far off its all-time intraday high of 3,050.88.
Dealers said SAP's better-than-expected results were still attracting interest to the market and Wall Street's further advance in early Friday trading were holding the market up.
